headline: Pemex Pipeline Explosion Sparks Fire in Cadereyta, Mexico
summary: State oil company Pemex deployed specialized personnel to contain an explosion and ensuing fire on a pipeline in Cadereyta, Nuevo León.
why: Pemex is Mexico's state-owned oil conglomerate, and pipeline incidents can disrupt local energy processing and industrial supply.

impacts.name: Pemex
impacts.why: Pipeline accidents disrupt operational continuity and require costly infrastructure repairs.
